name: Lifestyle Day in the Life
description: Day-in-the-life vlog format — structured time-of-day segments with ambient energy shifts. Best for 'day in my life', routine content, productivity lifestyle, and aspirational day-in-the-life content.
voice_style: natural, conversational, warm — voiceover narrates each segment; transitions mark time-of-day shifts; energy rises mid-day and relaxes by evening
music_mood: playlist-style progression — calm ambient morning, upbeat electronic afternoon, mellow acoustic evening, peaceful night

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: 5am. The house is completely silent. This is my favorite hour — no notifications, no one needing anything from me. Just me and the work.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Dark bedroom transitioning to golden 5am light, alarm clock close-up, coffee brewing in slow motion, person walking barefoot to desk, morning fog outside window, cozy aesthetic
scene_sequence.camera_movement: slow time-lapse from dark to light, cinematic push-in to desk, steady tracking shot to coffee
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: pre-dawn: very dim blue ambient; dawn transition: golden hour light creeping in; warm cozy lamp on desk as focal point
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: 5am atmosphere is the hero — dark-to-golden light transition is cinematic; foggy window detail adds mood

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Deep work block. Phone is across the room. Notebooks open. Three-hour sprint on the most important project of the day. This is where the real output happens.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Clean desk setup from overhead angle, laptop screen visible with work, coffee cup, notebook with handwriting, person typing in flow state, music playing on speakers, time-lapse of hours passing
scene_sequence.camera_movement: overhead static on desk, macro close-up on notebook writing, slow time-lapse across work session
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm desk lamp as key light, natural window light as secondary, laptop screen glow, cozy productive warmth
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Overhead desk setup is an aspirational visual; time-lapse across work session creates satisfying 'deep work' visualization

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Lunch break. Real food, not at my desk. 30 minutes to disconnect completely. Non-negotiable.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person making a simple meal, food plating in close-up, eating at a proper table by window, phone face-down on counter, person stretching or walking outside briefly
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium shot of meal prep, overhead plating close-up, static medium on person eating, smooth walk outside
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: bright natural window light, clean white plates, fresh food tones, peaceful daylight
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Phone face-down detail is the emotional anchor — it signals the boundary; bright daylight signals energy and rest

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Afternoon sprint. Meetings done. Admin done. Two more hours of focused afternoon work — lighter tasks, emails, anything that doesn't need peak cognitive energy.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Afternoon light shifting through office window, person responding to messages, calendar check, afternoon coffee or tea, person making quick calls
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium shots, calendar/phone inserts, steady pace cuts between tasks
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: golden afternoon light through window, warm amber tones, relaxed but productive energy
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Afternoon light is visually distinct from morning — warmer and more golden; calendar/phone inserts are productivity lifestyle markers

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: 5:30pm. Laptop closed. This is the boundary. No work emails after this hour. Workout, dinner, time with people I care about. Work was the means — not the point.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Laptop closing in slow motion, gym bag being packed or workout clothes changing, sunset light through window, person heading out the door, smile at camera
scene_sequence.camera_movement: slow motion on laptop closing, cinematic wide shot of sunset, smooth tracking to door
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm golden sunset through window, triumphant warm tones, laptop closing as metaphor highlighted with rim light
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Laptop-closing-in-slow-motion is the visual thesis statement; sunset light makes it cinematic

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: That's a day in my life. What does yours look like? Drop it in the comments. And follow for more.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Evening calm scene, person relaxed on couch or balcony, starry sky or city lights, follow button on screen, person looking at camera with slight smile
scene_sequence.camera_movement: static medium close-up on relaxed person, starry city lights in background, warm direct address
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm evening ambient, city lights or stars in background, soft cool blue night tones contrasting warm person light
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Evening CTA contrasts busy day — calm energy signals community invitation; starry background adds aspirational quality
